worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.summary: Vibrate to push out a cone of sound along the ground that passes through walls: every enemy in the cone takes special damage, heavier up close, and may have its Sp. Def lowered by 1 stage.
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.use.0: Sweep everyone in a cone at close-to-mid range
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.use.1: Reach a target even through a low wall
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.use.2: Suppress a cluster with full-power sound at point-blank
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.description.0: The sound wave deals %1$s special damage to each target it sweeps.
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.description.1: Each swept target has a %1$s chance to lose %2$s stage(s) of Sp. Def.
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.description.2: The cone opens %1$s degrees and reaches %2$s blocks, fading to %3$s of its power at the edge; walls do not stop sound.
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.growth.0: From level %1$s the buzz rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.bugbuzz.preference.dee: On: cone narrows to 0.72, range +2 blocks, less falloff, +3 ticks cooldown and +1 tick wind-up, but power ×0.94 — a long, narrow line. Off: a wider, looser shout with more power for close coverage.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it sound off from further away.
On: when other enemies stand within about 45 degrees of the target it prefers to buzz, catching several in one wave. Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
